name: Iwokrama Forest
blurb: Guiana Shield rainforest where jaguars, caimans and harpy eagles rule.

tip.title: Remove the tapirs
tip.text: Tapirs eat and spread the seeds of many rainforest plants and feed jaguars and caimans. Set South American tapir to -100% and watch the predators and the forest.

notes: The species list comes from GBIF occurrence records inside a circle around the park, so it can include nearby areas. Feeding links come from GloBI records and the sources listed where they state them; others are general ecology and are illustrative.

nodes.desc: Lowland rainforest turns tropical sunlight into leaves, flowers and fruit, the base of every food chain here.
Heavy rain keeps the lowland tropical forest of the Guiana Shield green and feeds the rivers that cross the reserve.
Break down fallen leaves, wood and carcasses, returning nutrients to the soil.
The best-recorded mammal around the reserve. Prefers Piper fruit but also eats other fruit, nectar, pollen and insects.

nodes.name: Leafcutter ant
nodes.desc: Cuts leaves and carries them to the nest to grow the fungus it feeds on. Ranges from Mexico to Bolivia, including the Amazon basin.

nodes.name: South American tapir
nodes.desc: A browser of leaves, shoots, fruit and aquatic plants that eats and spreads the seeds of many rainforest plants.
Giant air-breathing fish of the Amazon and Essequibo basins that eats fish, crustaceans, fruit, seeds and insects.
Hunts mostly fish, especially characins and catfish, in clear rivers of the Guianas and Amazon. Its numbers reflect river health.
Feeds mainly on carrion, often finding it by sight or by following Cathartes vultures. Among the most recorded birds near the reserve.
Canopy hunter whose prey is mostly tree-dwelling mammals; at nests in Guyana monkeys formed a large share of prey remains.
Top cat of the Americas, found in Guyana's forests and riverbanks. Takes capybara, peccaries, caiman and other prey as available.
Largest predator of the Amazon basin, living in rivers and swamps of southern Guyana. Eats fish including piranhas, and mammals.
